class.name: HSMCondition

method.name: _check
method.description: Returns whether the transition may be taken. Should be free of side effects: it may be called on every update. A condition that does not implement it never passes.

method.name: _generate_name
method.description: Returns the name shown by the editor for this condition. The script must be a [code]@tool[/code] script for the editor to call it. See [method get_display_name].

method.name: _setup
method.description: Called once, after the condition is bound to a machine. [member blackboard], [member agent] and [member machine] are available here.

method.name: get_display_name
method.description: Returns the display name: the result of [method _generate_name] for a tool script that implements it, otherwise the script file name in PascalCase ([code]in_combat.gd[/code] becomes [code]InCombat[/code]), otherwise [code]HSMCondition[/code].

method.name: is_bound
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] once the condition has been bound to a machine.

members.member: The agent the owning [LimboHSM] was initialized with. [code]null[/code] until bound.
The [Blackboard] of the [LimboHSM] that owns the transition. [code]null[/code] until bound.
The [LimboHSM] that owns and evaluates the transition. [code]null[/code] until bound.
